metadata.semantics: Int32MultiArray fixture; full payload and wire-byte oracle; copy into reused destination; serialize_owned returns freshly owned bytes; serialize_reuse consumes a borrowed result when MessageSerializer exists (historical owned-byte fallback otherwise); serialize_owned_reuse copies that result to fresh owned bytes; deserialization returns freshly owned message
metadata.latency_samples: batch elapsed time divided by batch operation count; not individual-message tail latency

build_manifest.serializer_api_detection: r2r/src/serialization.rs present: reusable API; absent: historical owned-byte API fallback for serialize_reuse modes
build_manifest.benchmark_cfg: --check-cfg=cfg(r2r_bench_serializer); --cfg r2r_bench_serializer only when serializer API exists
